description:
Kaizumi Lean Tools turns what you describe into the charts and sheets continuous improvement teams use every day. Tell ChatGPT about your process, paste your data, or upload a spreadsheet, and Kaizumi draws the tool right in the chat.

Problem solving: A3 report, 5 Whys, fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram, Pareto chart.
Flow: value stream map (VSM), takt time, kanban sizing, printable kanban cards, SIPOC, EPEI.
Standard work: time observation sheet, yamazumi operator balance chart, standardized work combination table, process capacity sheet, work instruction (TWI job breakdown).
Equipment: OEE, SMED changeover analysis.
Six Sigma: control chart (SPC), process capability (Cp, Cpk), FMEA, Gage R&R, DPMO and sigma level.

Every card can be edited in place. Each one opens in the matching free tool on kaizumi.com for printing or saving. No account or sign-in is needed.

defaultPrompt: Map the value stream for our bakery
Balance my line against a 60 second takt
Make a Pareto chart of our defects
